gaps.spec_claim: Returns a string representing the relative path from the parent directory of trace_dir to path. The returned path uses the platform-native path separator. When resolved from the parent directory of trace_dir, the returned path points to the same file system entry as path.
gaps.actual_behavior: The function returns a string result such that result is the relative path from the parent directory of trace_dir to path. No side effects occur. Formal: result = os.path.relpath(path, os.path.dirname(trace_dir))  type(result) = str.
gaps.trigger_condition: When trace_dir and path reside on different drives (e.g., C: and D: on Windows), os.path.relpath raises a ValueError because a relative path cannot cross drives. The specification requires the function to return a string for any input strings, so the exception violates the post-condition.
